summary: A Telegram contact persuaded a user to connect Trust Wallet to a fraudulent OMN smart contract site and approve transactions disguised as staking which drained an initial 3000 dollars then extracted another 12000 dollars through fake unlock requirements. The scam used social engineering and malicious contract approvals to steal funds after wallet interaction
user_mistake: trusted Telegram contact and approved malicious contract
prevention: Reject investment offers from messaging strangers / Simulate and inspect contract permissions before approval
